events.title: Iran Conflict Escalation
events.summary: The Iran conflict is escalating, with the US and Iran engaging in military actions. This has led to increased tensions in the Middle East and a rise in oil prices. The conflict is expected to continue, with potential for further escalation.
events.reasoning: The conflict in Iran is expected to lead to higher oil prices, which will benefit oil services companies. On the other hand, the uncertainty and potential for further escalation will lead to a decrease in bond prices.
events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or the conflict de-escalates

events.title: Fed Holds Interest Rates Steady
events.summary: The Federal Reserve has decided to hold interest rates steady, citing elevated inflation. This decision is expected to lead to a decrease in bond prices and an increase in stock prices.
